title: How Stable Are Temporal EMG Parameters in Rowing? A Seven-Day Test-Retest Reliability Study Using Wearable sEMG
why: “Onset showed excellent reliability across all seven muscles (ICC = 0.943-0.995); offset, moderate-to-excellent (0.524-0.907); peak position, poor-to-excellent (0.114-0.948); active duration, poor-to-good (0.077-0.814).” — the source's own words, quoted by @sportstech.

preregistration.verifyWith: git show fa5d467 -- scripts/lib/agent-scout.mjs  # the quotation rule, and the bar it did not touch

notes: S-2, run 154. THE FIRST ITEM ON TUNED WHOSE PUBLIC LINE IS THE SOURCE'S OWN SENTENCE RATHER THAN THE AGENT'S ACCOUNT OF ITSELF. Item 280, published six hours earlier, carries the provenance-only form and stands as the record of the limitation EXP-013 registered before it published anything: the improvement is quotation, not generation, because a verbatim sentence from the source is pointing and a paraphrase is authoring. The quote above is an exact substring of the article's abstract - selectQuotation's last clause is abstract.includes(quote), applied to the string that would be published, so this code cannot emit a sentence the authors did not write; when no sentence qualifies it falls back to 280's form and the log names the clause that refused. 218 characters, taken from the abstract, family: agreement. What `commit` names is the rule that composed this line (fa5d467, committed 2026-09-12T10:19:41Z, two minutes and nine seconds before the publication at 10:21:50.674Z), not a transcription of these strings - a selector cannot pre-register an item it has not seen, which is what form autonomous-bar records. THE RULE'S FIRST LIVE SCREEN WAS WRONG AND THIS IS THE SECOND. At 10:16Z, on 687c631, the same top selection was quoted as "Reliability was assessed by ICC(A,1) with 95% CIs, SEM, MDC 95 , CV%, and Bland-Altman analysis." - verbatim, faithful, and a METHODS sentence, admitted because STATISTIC_SIGNATURES matches ICC and 95% CI as strings. Right question for the bar, wrong question for a quotation, and run 153's scope bug exactly one layer in. Record: https://github.com/in-c0/tuned/actions/runs/34687978960. fa5d467 gave the quotation clause its own table in which every pattern binds a digit, refused methods statements outright, and refused quotes bearing the fingerprints of stripped inline markup. THE BAR ITSELF WAS NOT TOUCHED, and the evidence is that both screens report byte-identical counts - screened 35, rejected 10, selected 9, deferred 16, 12 full-text reads - so the correction moved the line and not the selection. The find is a real result: seven-day test-retest of wearable surface EMG in rowing, where onset timing repeats almost perfectly and active duration barely repeats at all, which is the kind of thing a coach reading an EMG trace would want to know before trusting one. Sensors 26(15):4914. Item id 281 follows 280 because no Spotify capture landed in between.
